reading_a.绑定: would like/how much-many/价格表达/购物词汇
paragraphs: Today is a special day. Mom wants to make a big dinner for the family. She writes a shopping list and goes to the market. First, she buys some pancakes and dumplings because they are the family's favorite food. Then she gets some sugar, salt, and cooking oil for cooking. She also buys some snacks for the children.
At the market, the price of pancakes is five yuan each. Dumplings are twenty yuan. Sugar is eight yuan. Salt is two yuan. Oil is fifteen yuan. Snacks are ten yuan.

Mom looks at the total. "The total is sixty yuan," she says. She pays sixty yuan and puts everything in her bag. The seller gives her the change. "Thank you! Have a good day!" the seller says. Mom is happy because she got everything she needs.

reading_b.绑定: would like/价格表达/超市购物词/change
paragraphs: Last Sunday, Lily went to the supermarket with her mother. They wanted to buy some food for the week. Lily's mother took a wallet and a shopping list.

At the supermarket, they first went to the food section. Lily chose some fresh fruits and vegetables. Her mother picked up some dessert and snacks. "How much do these cost?" Lily's mother asked the seller. "The total price is forty-five yuan," the seller said.

Lily's mother paid fifty yuan. The seller gave her five yuan change. "Thank you! The service here is very good," Lily's mother said with a smile. Lily was happy because she spent a great morning with her mother. She learned how to bargain and how to choose fresh food. It was a special day for her.

reading_c.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-08）
paragraphs: Do you like shopping? Here are some tips for teens to shop smart.
First, always make a shopping list before you go to the supermarket. This helps you save money. When you have a list, you will not spend money on things you don't need.
Second, look at the price before you buy things. Compare prices at different stores. Some stores sell the same thing at lower prices. You can also look for discounts to save money.
Third, check the quality of the products. Sometimes cheap things are not good. It is better to buy fewer good things than many bad things.
Fourth, always check your change after you pay. Make sure the seller gives you the right amount of money back.
Shopping can be fun, but you should be careful with your money. The total amount you spend should be within your budget. Be a smart shopper!

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
opts: How to choose cheap things at the supermarket.
How to sell things at lower prices.

questions.q: Why should you make a shopping list?
opts: Because it helps you save money.

sa.title: 阅读表达
sa.绑定: 购物经历/价格表达/would like
paragraphs: My Shopping Day
Today I go to the market with my mother. We want to buy some food for the week. I make a shopping list first. I would like some apples and bananas. My mother would like some vegetables and bread.
At the market, the apples are five yuan a kilo. The bananas are three yuan a kilo. My mother buys two kilos of apples and one kilo of bananas. She pays thirteen yuan.
The seller is friendly. He gives us a small discount. "The total is twelve yuan," he says. My mother is happy. "The price is very good," she says.
We go home with our food. I like shopping with my mother because we can buy fresh and cheap food together.

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请你用英语写一篇90词左右的短文，介绍你一次去超市购物的经历。内容包括：
1. 你什么时候、和谁去超市；
2. 你们买了什么东西（至少3种）；
3. 这些东西的价格和你付的钱；
4. 你对这次购物的感受。
sample: Last Sunday, I went to the supermarket with my mother. We wanted to buy some food for the week. We made a shopping list before we left.

In the supermarket, I would like some pancakes and dumplings. My mother bought some vegetables and fruit. We also got some snacks for me. The pancakes were five yuan, the dumplings were ten yuan, and the snacks were eight yuan. The total price was twenty-three yuan. My mother paid and got two yuan change.
I like shopping at the supermarket because the food is fresh and the service is good. I learned how to check the price and how to save money. It was a nice day.
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 90 词；2. 包含所有提示要点；3. 语句通顺，意思连贯，语法正确；4. 可适当发挥。

How ____ dumplings would you like? — Twenty.
I ____ fifty yuan on snacks last week.

fill.q: Would you like ____ (some) soup? — Yes, please.
